source.title: High-frequency trading in a limit order book
source.transcribed_by: model-assisted transcription from uploaded PDF; every value must be checked by hand against the page

simulation_params.fill_rule: ask filled with probability lambda(delta_a)*dt: q -= 1, wealth += s + delta_a; bid filled with probability lambda(delta_b)*dt: q += 1, wealth -= s - delta_b (page 222)
simulation_params.quote_timing: quotes computed from current state; state updated at t + dt (page 222; text says 'at time T', read as a typo for t)
simulation_params.symmetric_strategy_definition: uses the average bid/ask spread of the inventory strategy over the time period, centred on the mid-price (page 222)

transcription_notes: average_spread equals the time average of eq. 30 over [0, T]: gamma*sigma^2*T/2 + (2/gamma)*ln(1 + gamma/k) = 1.4908, 1.3489, 3.0217. This matches all three tables and independently confirms Table 3 uses gamma = 1.
Profit is not defined explicitly in section 3.3. Presumed terminal wealth plus inventory marked at the terminal mid.
